object.attr: analysis: a git client changing line endings, or the first edit of a hand-written file re-indenting it, turns links suspect with nothing to review. Same canonical form as Compare's MELLON-VER-SRS-22. Answered on 2026-11-10. Kept as should, because link states then depend on how files are parsed (CF-T28).
object.description: If a commit changes the target's files only in ways that the files' canonical forms don't show, Mellon should count the commit as no change to the target.
